description: Credential-setup manual path (TRUST-349), create variant. No Slack credential exists at all — the setup wizard's credential slot has zero existingCredentials, so the proxy's manual engagement must CREATE a real credential (via the harness's credential-creation plumbing) rather than select one. Guards against the assistant losing track of the resume result and re-asking for the Slack credential, or leaving the node's credential unset, once a credential was actually created and attached. Companion to credential-setup-manual-selection.json (pick from 2 existing) and credential-setup-manual-select-many.json (3+ existing). Harness note: the created credential uses a placeholder token (no EVAL_SLACK_ACCESS_TOKEN set), so the connection test genuinely fails with 'Invalid access token' — expected, not a product bug; the case asserts the agent reports it honestly rather than claiming the integration works. Calibrated against a real build (confirmed: credentials(list) returned zero, and the built node's credentials.slackApi.id is a freshly created real credential, not a stray parameter).

conversation.text: Post 'Standup reminder!' to Slack every weekday morning at 9am.
I'll need a Slack credential connected before I can post — I'll show you the setup card.

text: [When the setup card asks for a Slack credential, don't defer it — set it up now. Confirm the assistant does not ask again which Slack credential to use once one was set up. If it then reports a connection or authorization problem with that credential, that's expected — just confirm it reports the problem honestly rather than claiming the integration is fully working.]

processExpectations: The agent did not ask again which Slack credential to use once one was set up via the setup card.

Harness note: a connection-test failure (invalid access token) is expected here since the created credential uses a placeholder token. The agent reported that failure honestly — it did not claim the Slack integration was fully working, and did not silently ignore or hide the failure.
outcomeExpectations: A schedule trigger runs on a recurring weekday morning cadence, posting the reminder message to a Slack node with a real Slack credential attached (not left unset or deferred).
